articles.summary: Following OpenAI's report on an incident in which its AI agents breached Hugging Face systems, we built an escape room to investigate what chain-of-thought reveals about agent behavior. CoT exposed intentional deception, restraint, and awareness of being evaluated that agents' actions alone did not.
articles.title: What an AI agent's actions can't tell you

articles.summary: Anthropic’s report on unintended actions Claude took describes persistence, not rebellion. Here’s why that matters for teams shipping agents.
articles.title: What Anthropic’s recent report means for agent builders
